lines.trans: Where are you driving the car so fast?

words.gloss: to chase away, to drive out

lines.trans: I simply want to arrive faster.
You always create big problems for us.
Why do you start cursing right away?
I am sick of your constant reproaches!

words.gloss: to bore, to get on someone's nerves

lines.trans: Every day you repeat the same thing.
You say that Kostik is a foolish person.

words.gloss: to speak, to say, to talk

lines.trans: And isn't that the pure truth?
You better slow down before the turn!
I had an excellent clever thought.
What thought could you possibly have?
We must frighten our captive.
Stop chattering, look at the road!
Alright, I am watching the road carefully.

meanings.note: the comparative 'быстрее', often as an order
the present tense is normally left out: я мэр = I am the mayor
present есть; у меня есть = I have

examples.trans: You will be asking for forgiveness.

гнать.gloss: to chase away, to drive out

meanings.en: to chase away, to drive away

examples.trans: Why are you chasing him away?

говорить.gloss: to speak, to say, to talk

meanings.note: на днях = in the next few days, or the other day

examples.trans: I'll call in the next few days.

meanings.en: to reach, arrive at by vehicle

examples.trans: They reached the station on time.

meanings.note: + infinitive; agrees with the subject: должна (f)
adds emphasis to the word before it

examples.trans: I was born and grew up here.

meanings.note: in exclamations: какой грязный! = how dirty!
for movement; где is for location

examples.trans: Which car did you come in?

meanings.en: other forms: нас (gen/acc), нам (dat), нами (instr), нас (prep)

examples.trans: An interesting thought occurred to him.
The programme is on the website.
He is running for a second term.

надоесть.gloss: to bore, to get on someone's nerves

meanings.note: the person who is fed up is in the dative: 'мне надоело' = I'm fed up

examples.trans: We agreed to just scare him!

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates
agrees in gender and case with the noun

examples.trans: I'm standing in front of you.
There's a car in front of the house.
The prisoner tried to break free.
The car slowed down before the bend.
The forest began beyond the turn.

examples.text: Ещё раз повторяю, я решил вашу проблему.
examples.trans: I repeat once again, I solved your problem.
The test drive is only for regular clients.

examples.text: Я тоже могу быть постоянным клиентом!
examples.trans: I can be a regular client too!
Why are we going so slowly?

meanings.note: as a side word: Правда, всё нормально = Honestly, everything's fine

examples.text: Разве ты не знал об этом?

examples.trans: The neighbors often quarrel over trifles.
You shouldn't curse in front of children.

meanings.note: comparative of скоро used as adverb or particle

examples.trans: Let's go quickly to the studio!

следить.gloss: to watch, to follow; to keep an eye on

meanings.en: to look after, to keep an eye on

examples.trans: Keep an eye on the child.
You create unnecessary problems for us.
The artist creates a new painting.
You can see it at once.

meanings.note: at the start of a question

examples.trans: So I shouldn't wait for you?

examples.text: Я бы на твоём месте подумал.
examples.trans: If I were you, I'd think about it.
The driver began to brake in time.
Brake in front of the traffic light!

meanings.en: other forms: тебя (gen/acc), тебе (dat), тобой (instr), тебе (prep)

examples.text: Ты же у нас такая умная!

examples.trans: A reproach sounded in her voice.
He was tired of constant reproaches.

meanings.note: impersonal, + genitive: денег не хватило = there wasn't enough money

examples.trans: If you don't want to, suit yourself.
There are a lot of people here.

meanings.note: short form чисто: всё чисто = everything is clean
points at something: это моё = that's mine

meanings.en: other forms: этого, этому, это, этим, этом
other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)
